chunks: Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Ibn Udhayna.
Regarding women: if they have a child, they are given from the landed property.

key_terms.الرِّبَاعِ: landed property or real estate from an estate
key_terms.النِّسَاءِ: women, as legal heirs in the ruling
key_terms.وَلَدٌ: a child, which affects the inheritance ruling

ai.seo_question: When do women receive a share from landed property in inheritance law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about women’s inheritance, stating that when they have a child, they receive a share from landed property. It reflects a fiqh discussion on estate division and the circumstances affecting entitlement.
